rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: HARyearn
Exhibition name: Lady Mitchell
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, 1991).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1991 as 'Lady Mitchell'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Mild, fruity fragrance. 50 petals. Medium, very double, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage:
Dr. Darley ×
Silver Jubilee ® (hybrid tea, Cocker before 1974)
